title: Scuba

services.name: scuba gear
services.desc: If it’s been a while since your last dive, sign up for our PADI Scuba Review Course. We’ll go over scuba diving theory (or you can sign up for PADI’s eLearning) and review confined water skills for your upcoming scuba vacation. Test dive your equipment in our heated, salt water pool to make sure everything is in tip-top shape. How about your wet suit? Be sure your suit is appropriate for the dive’s water temps and duration. Check zippers, straps and releases before you go-don’t want to be on a remote island without a dive shop and find that you need new gear. If you need new gear, our gear specialists will fit you up. Our staff dives and most are instructors-we know what works well and what
